name: LottoLens PH Public PCSO Data
description: Free read-only API for a fixed Philippine PCSO results snapshot and normal draw schedules, with row-level provenance and explicit non-prediction limits.
notes: The public API exposes a fixed 13,457-row historical-results snapshot and nine normal draw schedules without login or payment. It includes public documentation, OpenAPI 3.1, HTTPS, CORS, row-level source URLs, checksums, coverage limits and clear independent/non-official boundaries. It does not sell tickets, accept wagers or claim prediction. Submitted on behalf of LottoLens PH.
